description: This file defines message structures and classes for inter-process communication within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes classes for framing, input/output messages, initialization, setup, and IPC message types, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and message handling.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a data frame with serialization and deserialization capabilities, used for message passing.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Represents an input message with methods to set and retrieve implementation, interface, and method identifiers.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Represents an output message with methods to add implementations and serialize message data.

classes.name: Init
classes.description: Represents an initialization message with various types (ACQUIRE, OFFER, REVOKE, REQUEST) and associated data.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Represents setup configuration data including implementation, sequence number, proxy stub path, messaging, and warning categories.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Converts an incoming value to Core::instance_id, accommodating 32-bit and 64-bit systems.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object data into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte stream into the object.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets message data fields such as implementation, interface ID, method ID, etc.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a numeric value from the message data at a specified offset.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Retrieves a text string from the message data at a specified offset.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the message data is valid based on its size.

methods.name: Action
methods.description: Sets the remote action mode in the message.

methods.name: Implementation
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation ID from the message.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Retrieves the interface ID from the message.

methods.name: MethodId
methods.description: Retrieves the method ID from the message.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size of the message data.
